description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers itself and Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Magister of Worth.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers once for each creature that enters under your control.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature if desired.
Repeat steps 7 and 8 once for each creature if desired.
Resolve all abilities from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target for each one.
Repeat from 3.
